program.name: Swift Agent — Management API
program.description: Cognito User Pool infrastructure, user identity layer, JWT auth middleware, and /v1/management/* routes for workspace and API key lifecycle.

packages.name: infra/modules/cognito
packages.description: Terraform module: Cognito User Pool, app client, domain, outputs

packages.name: @swiftagent/db
packages.description: Users and user_workspaces tables, repos (extends existing package)

packages.name: @swiftagent/api
packages.description: Cognito JWT auth plugin and /v1/management/* route handlers (extends existing package)

packages.name: @swiftagent/shared
packages.description: Cognito env var keys added to ENV_KEYS (extends existing package)

packages.name: apps/server
packages.description: Management plugin wired into service composition (extends existing app)

entities.name: User
entities.notes: New table. Maps Cognito identity to internal usr_ ID.

entities.name: UserWorkspace
entities.notes: New join table. role: owner | member.

extendedEntities.name: Workspace
extendedEntities.notes: Existing table from product-x WS-03. No schema changes; new repos query via user_workspaces join.

extendedEntities.name: ApiKey
extendedEntities.notes: Existing table from product-x WS-03. No schema changes; management routes add create/list/revoke lifecycle.

managementEndpoints.purpose: Get current user profile (auto-create on first call)
Create an API key (returns raw key once)

outOfScope: Team/organization management (multi-user workspace invitations, role changes)
